facts.fact: POTRAZ, as the designated Data Protection Authority, states in its implementation guidelines that it will not permit highly sensitive information such as core banking platforms and critical financial systems to be hosted outside Zimbabwe and that such systems must be hosted locally; the document gives no date, so its published date of 2025-01-01 is used.
facts.system: POTRAZ Data Protection Authority Implementation Guidelines (cross-border data transfers, sensitive information)
